summary: Off-registry dependency pinned to mutable HEAD tarball
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as a direct https tarball URL `https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/libsignal-node/archive/HEAD.tar.gz` instead of a registry version range. The URL references the repository's default branch (`HEAD`) with no commit SHA, version tag, or integrity hash. `npm install` fetches whatever bytes this URL returns at install time and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in that archive. Because the source is a mutable branch outside the npm registry, the contents can change at any time without any change to this package, bypassing registry-side integrity and audit controls.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
